one_line: Saka noble and patron of caves, monks, Brahmins and travellers in western India under Nahapana.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, tall and broad-shouldered, athletic build with a dignified bearing.
appearance.face: Oval face with strong jawline, straight nose, medium-deep wheatish complexion, neatly trimmed moustache and short boxed beard; sharp dark eyes with slightly arched brows, default expression calm, composed and observant with a hint of reserved warmth.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a short topknot at the back of the crown, sides kept short and tidy; a narrow plain gold circlet worn low on the forehead, with a small central green stone, and a simple cotton headband tied under the circlet at the back.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate Saka-elite in western Deccan: a long-sleeved, knee-length fitted tunic of undyed off‑white cotton with a subtle woven stripe texture, side slits at the hips; over it a wrapped reddish‑maroon woollen shawl draped over the left shoulder and across the torso like a himation, its border bearing a narrow geometric band in muted gold; straight, slightly tapered trousers in soft dull‑green cotton tucked neatly into mid‑calf brown leather boots with simple stitching; a broad leather belt dyed dark brown with a bronze buckle and small hanging ring for his scabbard; jewellery limited to a pair of small gold hoop earrings, a plain gold torque-style neckband, and a single thick gold bangle on his right wrist, all modest rather than ostentatious; he sometimes carries a folded light cotton scarf in cream tucked at his belt, hinting at travel and rest‑house visits.
appearance.signature: A sheathed straight double‑edged iron sword of Indo‑Scythian type, medium length, with a simple slightly flared bronze crossguard and a plain brown leather-wrapped grip, worn hanging from his belt at the left hip in a dark-brown leather scabbard whose chape and locket are reinforced with undecorated bronze fittings.

ref_desc: Ushavadata is a tall, broad-shouldered Saka noble in an off-white knee-length tunic, dull-green trousers, reddish-maroon shawl, brown boots, gold circlet and modest jewellery, black hair in a short topknot, trimmed moustache and beard, carrying a plain sheathed bronze-hilted sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Ushavadata, a tall, broad-shouldered early-2nd-century CE Saka noble in western India: he has a wheatish complexion, oval face, strong jaw, straight nose, sharp dark eyes, neatly trimmed moustache and short boxed beard, with thick black hair tied into a short topknot at the back of the crown. On his head is a narrow plain gold circlet with a small central green stone, held in place by a simple cotton headband tied at the back. He wears a long-sleeved, knee-length fitted off-white cotton tunic with subtle woven stripe texture and side slits, over straight dull-green cotton trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots with simple stitching. A reddish-maroon woollen shawl with a narrow muted-gold geometric border is draped over his left shoulder and across his torso like a himation, suggesting both rank and practicality. Around his waist is a broad dark-brown leather belt with a bronze buckle, from which hangs a dark-brown leather scabbard with plain bronze fittings, holding his signature straight double-edged iron sword with a simple slightly flared bronze crossguard and brown leather-wrapped grip. Add small gold hoop earrings, a plain gold neck torque, and a single thick gold bangle on his right wrist, and tuck a folded cream cotton travel scarf at his belt; pose him calmly, with composed, observant expression, showing front, side and back views while keeping the colours consistent: off-white tunic, reddish-maroon shawl, dull-green trousers, brown boots and belt, muted gold accents.
